title: Regenerate the three portfolio section images

requirements.text: Create updated premium, minimal portfolio thumbnail images for the three elements in the Home page Portfolio/Recent Work section (the 3 project card images), keeping a consistent visual style across all three images and maintaining the existing 1200x900 dimensions.
acceptanceCriteria: Three new/updated portfolio thumbnails exist as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated with the filenames specified in imageRequirements.edits targets.
Each image is 1200x900 and visually consistent with the site’s premium minimal aesthetic (clean, modern, minimal color, subtle lighting; no busy multicolor gradients).
The three images are distinct from one another (not duplicates) while still matching as a set.

requirements.text: Update the Portfolio section to use the newly generated portfolio image filenames for the three project cards (only the selected Portfolio elements in section 5).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/marketing/PortfolioSection.tsx references the new portfolio image paths for the three projects.
Only the portfolio card images in the Portfolio section are changed; no other images/sections are modified.
The Portfolio section renders without broken images (no 404s) and the images maintain the existing aspect ratio and object-cover behavior.

constraints: Apply changes ONLY to the three selected Portfolio section elements (the three project card images in section 5); do not modify other page elements or other images.
Keep image dimensions at 1200x900 and keep the existing Portfolio layout and hover behavior intact.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Changing hero images, background textures, or any non-portfolio imagery.
Changing portfolio copy (titles/categories/descriptions) or adding/removing portfolio items.
Backend changes or adding new backend methods.
